notes:
Compound motifs are built from `A` (scaffold) and `B` (substituent) with `template`.
For most motifs, `A` is the scaffold side and `B` is the functional group side; therefore `anchors` is optional.
When present, `anchors` may override defaults; if absent, assume anchors.core='A' and anchors.fg='B'.
Attachpoints are inferred from atom-maps in the referenced group `smarts` (see organic_groups v1.3).
